ns2:section.sectionText: Family Advocacy Project This section will meet in room 318 of the Psychological Services Center. The Community Project courses typically involve orientations and an application process prior to instructor approval to enroll. Orientations occur in late March and early April for the following academic year. 340/341 courses involve a two-semester commitment. Check on the Psychology Advising Office website for information regarding each course offering and how to apply.
